vocabularies.name: CommandErrorCode
vocabularies.description: Why thread.command refused a command: the data.code of its JSON-RPC error.

vocabularies.name: ThreadStatus
vocabularies.description: What a thread is doing, derived from its turns, requests and queue.

vocabularies.name: OriginKind
vocabularies.description: How a thread began: a person's chat, a spawned child, or a provider's own subagent.

vocabularies.name: Hold
vocabularies.description: Why a thread's queue waits, and so who may release it; absent when nothing holds it.

vocabularies.name: StartedBy
vocabularies.description: What started a turn.

vocabularies.name: DeliveryKind
vocabularies.description: Who a delivery is from: a person's prompt, an agent's message, a reply, a daemon notice.

vocabularies.name: DeliveryMode
vocabularies.description: How a delivery goes: as the next turn, or into the running one.

vocabularies.name: DeliveryState
vocabularies.description: Where a delivery is on its way to the agent.

vocabularies.name: ActorKind
vocabularies.description: Who sent a delivery or issued a command.

vocabularies.name: WakeMode
vocabularies.description: When a spawned thread's parent hears from it.

vocabularies.name: ThreadEventKind
vocabularies.description: Which change a thread.event notification carries.

vocabularies.name: ThreadListKind
vocabularies.description: Whether a thread.list item is the snapshot, an upsert or a removal.

vocabularies.name: TurnState
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle state of a turn.

vocabularies.name: StreamKind
vocabularies.description: What streamed text adds to.

vocabularies.name: EnvelopeKind
vocabularies.description: What a block maiD wrapped around text it sent an agent carries.

vocabularies.name: HistoryQuality
vocabularies.description: How well a provider rebuilds a session run outside maiD from its own record.

vocabularies.name: ApprovalDecision
vocabularies.description: Client decision on an approval request.

vocabularies.name: AuthKind
vocabularies.description: How a sign-in method or challenge proceeds.

vocabularies.name: AttachmentKind
vocabularies.description: What a message or tool attachment carries.

vocabularies.name: StopReason
vocabularies.description: Why a completed turn ended early; absent when it finished normally.

vocabularies.name: OutputFormat
vocabularies.description: How to render tool output; absent means plain text.

vocabularies.name: QuestionKind
vocabularies.description: Input a user-input question takes.

vocabularies.name: AccessLevel
vocabularies.description: How much a session may do without asking, from read_only to full; absent when its mode isn't mapped.

vocabularies.name: ItemKind
vocabularies.description: Kind of an entry of a session's conversation.

vocabularies.name: ItemStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle status of an entry.

vocabularies.name: GoalStatus
vocabularies.description: Status of the goal a provider pursues over its turns.

vocabularies.name: ToolAction
vocabularies.description: Action a provider explicitly stated for a tool call; absent when it stated none.

vocabularies.name: FileChangeKind
vocabularies.description: Kind of a normalized file mutation produced by a tool.

vocabularies.name: ConfigOptionType
vocabularies.description: Control a session config option renders as.

vocabularies.name: ConfigOptionCategory
vocabularies.description: Advisory grouping hint for a session config option; unknown values must be tolerated.

vocabularies.name: PlanEntryStatus
vocabularies.description: Status of an execution-plan checklist entry.

vocabularies.name: PlanEntryPriority
vocabularies.description: Priority of an execution-plan checklist entry.

vocabularies.name: InstanceStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle of a provider instance: configured but never started this run, alive, or exited.

vocabularies.name: AuthStatus
vocabularies.description: Provider authentication state. Unknown means the agent advertises auth methods but exposes no probe.

vocabularies.name: TerminalStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle of a terminal thread's shell run. Unknown future values must render as a neutral unavailable state.

vocabularies.name: TerminalStreamItemKind
vocabularies.description: Payload discriminator of a terminal.subscribe notification.

vocabularies.name: TerminalListStreamItemKind
vocabularies.description: Payload discriminator of a terminal.subscribeList snapshot or update.

vocabularies.name: TerminalProgramState
vocabularies.description: What a terminal's program reported doing (OSC 7501). Blocked renders as needing the user; unknown future values render neutrally.

vocabularies.name: TerminalProgramNeed
vocabularies.description: What a blocked terminal program needs from the user. Unknown future values render like no need given.

vocabularies.name: TerminalColorScheme
vocabularies.description: Whether a terminal view's theme is light or dark.
